faqs.q: Can I enroll in a course right now?
faqs.a: Not yet. The courses you see are samples, and enrollment isn't open. We'll announce the opening schedule as soon as it's ready.

faqs.q: When will mentors and community open?
faqs.a: Learning content comes first, and mentors and community are being prepared as the next stage. We'll tell you here first when they open.

faqs.q: Can I follow the guides as they are?
faqs.a: The guides are samples to help you understand. For decisions about visas, law or health, always confirm with the relevant official agency.
